newsitem.title: USA: Rock-Tenn completes Davey Co acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Rock-Tenn completes Davey Co acquisition.

text.p: Rock-Tenn Co said Wednesday it had completed acquiring the assets of Davey Co in exchange for about 863,500 shares of Rock-Tenn Class A common stock, subject to certain post-closing adjustments.

Davey makes recycled paperboard for book makers to use as book covers. The company had annual sales of about $25 million in 1996, Rock-Tenn said. The acquisition included Davey's manufacturing facilities in Jersey City, New Jersey and Aurora, Illinois, and certain manufacturing equipment of Davey's other manufacturing facility in Downingtown, Pennsylvania.
Rock-Tenn makes packaging, 100 percent recycled paperboard and laminated paperboard products. It has over 70 manufacturing operations in the United States and Canada.
